overview.title: Personal page
overview.subtitle: A short link, decatron.net/@name, with your socials, your photo and your style

blocks.x: Each channel can have its own page at decatron.net/@name: a single address to share all your socials and links, with your photo, your colors and your font.
It is free. It is not tied to any other module: anyone who wants one can create it.

For now pages can be prepared and published, but only their owner, people with full control of the channel and the Decatron team can see them. They will open to the public when the Decatron team enables it.

items: 3 to 25 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore, not starting or ending with a hyphen or underscore.
The first person to register a name keeps it. If you think a name belongs to you, you can send an appeal and the Decatron team reviews it.
It can be changed once every 30 days. The previous name leads to the new page for 30 days and then becomes free.
Some names are reserved (site routes and system words).
Photo (your channel's or your own), display name and a short bio.
Socials from a list: Twitch, Kick, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Discord, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, OnlyFans and Fansly. Each one only accepts addresses from that social.
Custom links with their title. They must all start with https:// and link shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl…) aren't accepted, because they hide where the link goes.
Five templates to choose from (Scene, Badge, TV channel, Inventory and Poster), in a light or dark theme, with the accent color and font you choose. All of them use the same content.
With the Scene template, the top can be a layered canvas: background (stripes, a color, or an image, GIF or video from your media gallery), photo, name, bio, stickers and free texts.
YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok videos embedded on the page, plus photos and sounds from your media gallery.

blocks.x: Links to 18+ sites are allowed, but adult photos or videos are never uploaded to Decatron: links only.

items: The owner marks their whole page or each link as 18+. Known adult sites (OnlyFans, Fansly and others) are marked automatically and can't be unmarked.
Visitors to an 18+ page must confirm they are 18 or older before seeing it. On a regular page, 18+ links are covered and ask for that confirmation before opening. It's remembered in that browser.
An 18+ page doesn't show up in search engines and, when its link is shared, the preview has no photo or bio.
Custom links always show the real domain they go to.
Anyone who is signed in can tap «Report this page» at the bottom of the page. A person on the Decatron team reviews every report; nothing is hidden automatically.

blocks.x: The age confirmation is the visitor's own statement: Decatron doesn't verify anyone's age.
Log in, open My page in the panel menu, choose your name and follow the Guide. Nothing shows until you tap Publish.

guide.title: My page
guide.subtitle: Create, design and publish your decatron.net/@name page

items: Open My page in the panel menu.
Type the name you want. Below the field you will see whether it is available.
Tap Create my page. It is created with your channel name, its photo and an accent color taken from that photo.

blocks.x: If the name already belongs to someone else, you can choose another one or tap Claim this name and explain why it belongs to you (10 to 1000 characters).

head: Tab
What it does
rows: Guide
The steps to get the page ready and the important notices.
Profile
Photo (upload one or use the channel's), display name (up to 50 characters), bio (up to 300) and whether the whole page is 18+.
Socials and links
Add networks from the list or custom links, reorder, hide or remove them, and mark which ones are 18+.
Media
Embedded videos (YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok), photos and sounds from your gallery.
Appearance
Template (with a preview of each one using your content), light or dark theme, accent color (by hand or taken from your photo) and font.
Scene
Only with the Scene template: the top of the page as a layered canvas, with the same editor as your overlays.
Name
Your current link, change the name, send appeals and see their status.

blocks.x: On the right, the preview shows the draft on a phone or desktop, even before saving.

head: Template
How it looks
rows: Scene
Your photo and your name in large type over a scene, with socials as tiles and links below.
Badge
A backstage pass hanging from a strap in your accent color, with photo, @name and a QR code that opens your page. Tap «Flip the badge» to see your socials; 18+ links carry a stamp.
TV channel
Your channel ident on top and your socials as a numbered channel guide.
Inventory
Your socials as game inventory slots. Tap a slot to open its card with the Open button.
Poster
Your name fills the width like a tour poster and your socials appear as credits.

items: Switching templates erases nothing: all of them use the same content. Choosing one suggests its font, which you can change.
In Inventory, each link can take a 1×1, 2×1 or 2×2 slot. In Poster, each social can be small, medium or large; if none is large, the first one is shown large.
The size is set in Socials and links and only appears when you use one of those two templates.

blocks.x: With the Scene template selected, the Scene tab appears. Tap «Use the layered scene»: it starts with the photo, name and bio where the classic design has them, and from there you move and resize each item like in your overlays.

items: Background: stripes, a color, or an image, GIF or video from your media gallery. Video plays muted and on a loop; if the visitor asked for reduced motion, it stays still.
Stickers: images or GIFs from your gallery, up to 20.
Free texts: up to 10, up to 120 characters each, with font, size, color and alignment.
Photo, name and bio come from Profile; in the scene you only choose where they go and how they look. You can hide them.
Each layer can be hidden, brought forward or sent backward; stickers and texts can also be duplicated or removed.
The canvas is 4:5 and looks the same, just bigger or smaller, on phone and desktop. Your socials and links stay below.
«Back to the classic design» turns the scene off without deleting your layers.

blocks.x: Files come from your media gallery, the same one Timer and Alerts use, and count toward your plan's storage. If you delete from the gallery a file the scene uses, it stops showing and My page tells you to change it.

items: Save draft keeps your changes without showing them.
Publish shows on your link what you have in the draft. Publishing needs a display name.
Discard changes takes the draft back to what is published.

blocks.x: If you edit the page in two tabs or someone else edits it at the same time, you will see a notice to reload when saving. That way nobody overwrites the other's changes without noticing.

items: PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF up to 10 MB are accepted. The photo is saved at 512 px, as WEBP and without hidden image data.
When you upload a photo, an accent color taken from it is suggested. You can change it any time.
Take it from my photo recalculates the color from the current photo.
Every link must start with https://.
Each social on the list only accepts its own domain: for example, Instagram only accepts instagram.com.
Free links need a title of up to 60 characters.
You can have up to 100 links.
A hidden link is saved but not shown on the page.
Link shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl…) aren't accepted in custom links: paste the site's real address.
If a link goes to a site blocked for safety, the editor marks it in red and won't save until you remove it.
Videos: paste the link to a video or channel from YouTube (Shorts too), Twitch (channel, video or clip), Kick (channel) or TikTok (video). Nothing is uploaded: the official player is shown. Up to 10.
The player only loads when the visitor taps «Play»: the page loads fast and those platforms receive nothing from the visitor until they choose to watch.
Photos: images or GIFs from your media gallery, with an optional description. They open full size when tapped. Up to 12.
Entry sound: plays once when the visitor taps «Enter». Button sound (off by default): plays when tapping your socials and links. One volume for both.
With a sound chosen, your page shows «Enter» first, because browsers don't play audio without a tap. Visitors can enter without sound and always have a mute button.
Videos and photos show below your socials and links in all five templates, in each template's style.

blocks.x: Photos and sounds count toward your plan's storage in the media gallery. If you delete from the gallery a file your page uses, it stops showing and My page tells you.

items: Whole page: in Profile, turn on «My whole page is 18+». Visitors will have to confirm they are 18 or older before seeing anything.
One link: in Socials and links, check «This link is 18+». It's covered until the visitor confirms their age; for a custom link, its title stays hidden until then.
OnlyFans, Fansly and other known adult sites are marked 18+ automatically and can't be unmarked.
An 18+ page doesn't show up in search engines and, when shared, the preview has no photo or bio.
If the Decatron team marks your page as 18+ after a report, the switch stays on and you'll see a notice in Profile.

blocks.x: The age confirmation is the visitor's own statement, not a verification. Adult photos or videos are never uploaded to Decatron: only links.

At the bottom of every page there's a «Report this page» button. Using it requires signing in with Twitch, Kick or Discord. The visitor picks a reason (unmarked adult content, scam or dangerous link, impersonation, hate or harassment, copyright or something else), and optionally the specific link and details.

items: A person on the Decatron team reviews every report. Nothing is hidden automatically.
They can dismiss it, hide the page (you'll see the reason at the top of My page), mark it as 18+ or block the site of the reported link.
Your page doesn't show the button to you, and a page owner doesn't see who reported it.
It can be changed once every 30 days. The Name tab shows from which date you can do it again.
The previous name leads to your new page for 30 days. During that time nobody else can take it and you can get it back.
If the Decatron team accepts an appeal for your name, your page moves to a temporary name and you can choose a new one without waiting 30 days.

blocks.x: You and anyone with full control of your channel. Moderators and editors with fewer permissions do not see My page.
For now your published page can only be seen by you, people with full control and the Decatron team (with a preview notice at the top). It will open to the public when the Decatron team enables it.
If the Decatron team hides your page, you will see the reason in My page.
